title: Event record (Contract B, v3)
description: THE authoritative event shape. Written as JSON Lines to events.jsonl, ascending by t_seconds. v3 adds the optional `goal` field.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, generated by component 1 -- corrections reference it before anything is stored.

track_id.description: Null for match-level events (match_start, match_end, phase_change), which belong to the match rather than any robot.

phase.description: Derived, not detected: a pure function of match-relative time and the season config.

goal.description: Which goal a shot went into. Null when unknown, and absent entirely from v2 producers. NOT a fixed enum: legal values are the `goals` array of the season config named by the job's `season`, because goal names change every season. Validated against that file, not against this schema.

corrected.description: Read-only annotation added by the API, not stored. Independent of `source`: a model event a human fixed keeps source 'model' and gains corrected: true.

correction_id.description: Read-only annotation added by the API.

allOf.$comment: Match-level events belong to the match, not a robot.
